purpose: Teach: くれれ/ならば/混入/マッチング/尚/４つ/小銭/おこっ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お電話くれればすぐ迎えに行くわよ
lines.en: Sho, if you call I'll come pick you up right away.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring, matter-of-fact. Opening with his name soft but clear. The promise delivered like a standing offer—not showy, just solid.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、雨ならば傘を持って行くね
lines.en: Mom, if it rains I'll bring an umbrella.
lines.style: Quiet, practical thinking aloud. A six-year-old who notices details and arranges them in his head. Small, certain voice—not asking permission, reporting a plan.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お料理に異物の混入がないか確認するわ
lines.en: Sho, I'll make sure there's nothing wrong with the food.
lines.style: Practical and attentive, the voice of a mother checking a list. Not hovering—just the everyday vigilance that lives beneath her composure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくのおもちゃ、お友達との趣味のマッチング、ぴったり
lines.en: Mom, my toy and my friend's hobby—they match perfectly.
lines.style: Small voice, genuinely pleased. He's worked this out and wants her to know. A child sharing something he's proud of, slowly, carefully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、尚、お祖母ちゃんが来るそうよ
lines.en: Sho, by the way, Grandma's coming.
lines.style: Casual update delivered in passing, but watching for his reaction. The kind of thing she files away to come back to if it matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくのおもちゃ、４つもあるよ
lines.style: A small, plain statement of fact. Not quite excited, not quite worried—just announcing something he's counting or thinking about.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お小銭、お財布にしまっておいてね
lines.en: Sho, put your coins away in your wallet, okay?
lines.style: Gentle instruction with the weight of everyday care behind it. Not commanding—more reminding, the way she'd check that he has his shoes on.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、なんでもないことがおこったよ
lines.style: Quiet, hesitant. A six-year-old reporting something he's not quite sure about, testing her reaction before he decides if it matters.
